name: Flame Busters
review:
Firefighters rescuing tenants from a burning building, on 243 ways. Wilds, fire symbols, a Fire Drill feature and free spins make up the features.

The Fire Drill can liven up ordinary spins, but the free spins hold most of the upside. The cartoon rescue story gives it more personality than the simple layout suggests. High volatility, 5,280x cap, 96.1% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
